note: Renders: scratchpad/w13 (m01-m19) and w13q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built as b13 = w12 final 25ae23e: bottleClear #6d7477 and tumbler #6a6a6e, both dielectric. The w14 candidate 9b9e317 (galley frames, welcome cabinet, ash flaps, flight-deck door) is NOT in these renders and is not rated here. The only monument change since w12 is the bar glassware, which is now mid grey instead of black. In this pass I re-checked the class curtains against the official ANA photo c_27312: the J curtains are navy-charcoal there, but the render's curtainC is warm brown. That pulls the curtain, F/J and J/PY scores down against w12b. Lighting is noted but not scored: the white fog on the upper galley compartments in m09/m01/m12, the flat grey q19 galley and the X-shaped light patch on the q11 far bulkhead. Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 (by luminance) over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Script: scratchpad/raterB/s.py.

details.note: The layout, blind, screen, fridge, ash cabinets (#c2b7a0 against the render's #c9bba3) and near-black counter all match samchui_render_11. The glassware is no longer black, but the bottles and tumblers are opaque matte grey, with no glass cues. The tubular fence rail on posts is still there, where the render has a flat aluminium edge band.

The ovens, brewer bay, monitor and recess surround are right. The glass cabinet is about 0.5x the screen width with a wide blank gap (the photo has about 0.7x, abutting), the pane is darker than the tower, and the round knob is wrong. The tower is olive-taupe #3e3b35 against #1d1d19 in omaat_room_32; that is partly lighting.

The flaps are oversized and abut one another, with blue-grey frames (#989ea4) and square corners. The ash grain is banded. lalf_133 shows separate, smaller flaps in neutral frames with rounded corners, plus the aluminium rails lower down.

issues.problem: Carried over from w12a. The cabinet is about 0.5x the screen width (0.7x in the photos), stands about 0.3 m clear of the screen with its top below the screen top, and its pane reads darker than the tower, so it looks like a hole rather than smoked glass.
issues.evidence: m03: cabinet x 585-760 against screen x 118-453; pane (620,210,720,290) #262122 against tower (470,120,570,320) #3e3b35, 0.6x. omaat_room_32: cabinet about 0.7x the screen, abutting it, pane (760,200,900,380) #2e2c2b against tower (700,140,760,400) #1d1d19, 1.5x.
issues.fix: As in w12a (in buildWelcomeGalley: width 0.62, left edge at the screen edge plus 0.03, top level with the screen, interior about 1.35x lighter). Already in the unrendered w14 candidate; render it to verify.

issues.problem: curtainC renders warm brown. The official photo and omaat_room_36 show cool navy-charcoal J curtains, and this is the largest single-hue error in the monument set: the curtains are central in three views.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js MONMAT.curtainC: c '#6b635d' -> '#5c5f6c' (keep r 0.95 and the fabric layer); curtainTie '#2e2b2d' -> '#2a2c33'. Target a rendered mean of about #3c3e48, with blue minus red at least +8.

issues.problem: The tone is fixed, but the bottles and tumblers are opaque matte grey, with no rims or edge highlights, so they read as plastic.
issues.evidence: m05 tumblers (205,428,290,455) #4b4c52, std 19, against samchui_render_11 (235,340,340,370) #2f2d32, p90 #686463. Bottle body std 21 against 23-36 in the reference, with no bright edge.
issues.fix: In bottle(): one 0.006-wide gQuad edge highlight on the body front in a new { c: '#d0d6d8', r: 0.1, e: 0.05 }. Tumbler: body to '#3a3c40', plus a gCyl rim ring (r 0.035, h 0.004) in the same highlight material at the top.

issues.problem: Carried over. The frames are blue-grey and abut one another, the corners are square and the ash is banded.
issues.evidence: m04 frame (60,250,85,500) #989ea4 (blue minus red +12); the gap between frames is about 6 px. In lalf_133 the flaps are separate, with neutral aluminium frames.
issues.fix: As in w12a (in the unrendered w14 candidate): spaced flaps, gRBox frames in a warm neutral '#a8a59f'.

issues.detail: Brewer pots and galley faces (m01, m09, m12, q19)
issues.problem: Carried over. The pots are faceted, the insert faces frameless, and the q19 pot reads as a sheared grey can.
issues.evidence: m09 pots (505-565, 330-395) are visibly banded; q19 (110-215, 385-525) #5a5d65 flat. sansY_44 has smooth polished pots and framed, riveted inserts.
issues.fix: Per-vertex smooth pot shading plus insert frames, rivets and posts (both in the w14 candidate; verify, including the q19 close-up).

issues.problem: The ash grain on the lav doors is coarse and smeared (horizontal streak bands), not the fine grain of lalf_133.
issues.evidence: m17 (200,100,310,500) #c5b89f, std 12.1, with visible bands; lalf_133 panels show a fine, faint grain.
issues.fix: Use the finer ashDoor layer (or halve the grain gain) for the lav door material.

issues.problem: A tubular rail on posts above the counter edge; samchui_render_11 has a flat aluminium edge band flush with the deck.
issues.evidence: m05 rail (100-910, 410-425) with posts; samchui (80-920, 375-390) flat band.
issues.fix: In buildBar: drop the posts and the raised tube, and keep only a 0.03-tall aluminium edge band at deck level.

gapWorth03.change: Render and rate the committed w14 candidate (9b9e317): galley insert frames, rivets and channel posts, plus the welcome cabinet resize. Together these clear the one medium welcome issue and the largest carry-over tell.
